messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Data do not pass through sourced R scripts in map phase, but OK in reduce phase
parts:
On Sun, Apr 28, 2013 at 7:31 PM, <guo...@gmail.com> wrote:
Here is something I'm thinking might be a potential bug for Rhipe 0.71
 
I have a R scripts named test.R in HDFS, with only the following command 
a <- b     
then I want to source it from both mapper and reduce phase,
  map <- expression({
      lapply(seq_along(map.values),function(r){
      b <- 0.5
      source('test.R')
      rhcollect(map.keys[[r]],c(b,a))
  })})
  reduce <- expression({
      b <- reduce.values
      source('test.R')})
  z <- rhmr(map, inout=c('lapply'),N=2,mapred=list(mapred.reduce.tasks=0),shared=c('/user/mydir/R/test.R'))
  rhex(z,async=FALSE)
 
It turns out it only works well when sourcing it in reduce, while it gave me this error in map phase,
R ERROR BEGIN (map):
=============
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'b' not found
R ERROR END
=========== 

You refer to 'b' before your source test.R If you need b from the environ,ment, call
 rhmr(,,..., param=list(b=b))



 
It looks like it would not pass along data while it execute commands in sourced R codes. But I’m still using Rhipe_0.71. Are you able to duplicate this error in your current version? 
 
Thanks very much

--

messages.author: a5ca085497920157
messages.subject: Re: Data do not pass through sourced R scripts in map phase, but OK in reduce phase
parts:
What is happening here is this:  "b <- .5" is inside a map expression. The Map expression does not get evaluated in the R global environment; however, "source" by defaults evaluates into the R global environment.  I believe the user work around is to do source(..., local=TRUE)


It may be possible to make Rhipe respond to this issue, but I am  not sure about the side effects of doing so at the moment. 

The map expression is evaluated by this line in the source:

https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/blob/master/code/R/src/mapreduce.cc#L266
Note the second argument to R_tryEval is NULL and it is the environment in which to evaluate Map expressions.  For comparison tryEval is basically the same as the eval documented here (but with a try logic)
http://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/R-exts.html#Evaluating-R-expressions-from-C

If desired it is possible to evaluate the Map expressions in the global environment by changing the second argument in line 266.  For example like that demonstrated here: 
http://developer.r-project.org/embedded.html

R_tryEval(runner2,R_GlobalEnv,&Rerr);


That would make Map expression evaluations and source(...,local=FALSE) creating variables in the same environment.

messages.author: 6ad445e8c05b52fc
messages.subject: Re: Data do not pass through sourced R scripts in map phase, but OK in reduce phase
parts:
Yeah, I traced back to that command as well. And I thought that might because global environment cannot be serialized, and you don't want to use the local environment where map expression gets evaluated as "global environment"

Similarly, if I call a function within mapper phase, and want to refer to a variable defined before the function and without passing it through argument of the function, I would get the same error too.

So I'm OK with the solution source(...., local=TRUE), and for the function call, just pass in every variable in the argument.

Also, correction, reduce phase has the same issue too, just it didn't show me the error message.
